replyReader.source: actual emitted schema of current_overview_bridge.lua / current_live_resource_probe.lua / opt-in map013_wrapper_trace.lua

replyReader.staleOrMismatched: fail closed, do not coerce identities or rely on opaque requestId

actualBranchOrder: read_world_ready command read and protected os.remove attempt (success not guaranteed)
begin_world_ready existing actual WorldScene, or SceneUtils.ChangeToWorld
pending_world_ready loop with 10 second source timeout
write_world_ready_result returns write status, previously ignored
host validates actual response and owner/freshness
worldReadySourceFlow.importantSilentRoute: read_world_ready attempts command deletion before version/token validation, ignores failure; schema/token mismatch silently returns nil with no result
worldReadySourceFlow.hostSnapshot: snapshot_worldready_stages; existence and identity booleans only, no secrets

inertFollowUpAfterA0eacc3e.sameSecondRequests: per-stage and sanitized per-request ID log suppression; former per-stage-only suppression could hide a second request
inertFollowUpAfterA0eacc3e.deferredControlLeaseRead: shared_read_deferred logged when busy shared read is admitted for deferral, before world processing

historicalToolDenial.retrievedFrom: previous turn's retained actual tool response and its invoking call
historicalToolDenial.exactReturnedText: Script error: This tool call was blocked by OpenAI because we couldn't determine the safety status of the request.
